completeness.why: All five link functions delegate the whole sequence (bank lookup call, upgrade-or-insert with throw, transfer payee, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event) to linkBankSyncAccount; each passes only its own data plus explicit arguments for the preserved variations (newAccount key set incl. mask/official_name, syncFileId only for Pluggy.ai, eventTables ['transactions'] for Akahu); the unreachable id==null check is dropped as dead code.

interface.why: Parameters map exactly to the real variations (institution, bankId, accountSyncSource, newAccount insert fields, optional syncFileId, eventTables) with no speculative options, and each preserved inconsistency is visible as an explicit argument at its call site.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed and replaced by thin wrappers that only map provider fields; the remaining similarity (institution/bankId mapping across SimpleFin/Pluggy/Akahu) is per-site data, not duplicated logic.
